subject: history
concept: Understanding that a major event (such as a significant plague) affected medieval populations dramatically
source_inspiration: original content, presented factually per the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a simplified population-impact chart showing before/after a major medieval event
exercise.pictorial: Student matches causes (like poor sanitation, trade routes spreading disease) to the event's spread
exercise.abstract: Student explains, at an age-appropriate level, why this event had such a large impact on medieval society

misconception_flags: cannot connect any real contributing factor to how the event spread or its impact

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
